name: Captain Barnaby Inkbeard
description: Thick lines, whip shading and solid black, in the old sailor manner. Holds up from across the harbour.

designs.title: Homeward Swallow
designs.description: A swooping swallow, the old mark of a sailor due back home. Bold wings and four small stars.

designs.title: Rope and Anchor
designs.description: A heavy anchor wrapped in rope, with whip-shaded arms. The steady classic for the upper arm.

designs.title: Dagger Through the Heart
designs.description: A dagger driven through a whip-shaded heart with three drops falling. Loyal, dramatic, a bit much.

designs.title: Old Harbour Rose
designs.description: A round traditional rose with half-black leaves. Fills a shoulder cap or the back of a hand.

designs.title: Lucky Horseshoe
designs.description: A nailed horseshoe holding a black star, for those who need the odds on their side.

designs.title: Rattler Coil
designs.description: A diamond-backed snake coiling up to a blunt black head, tail rattling behind it.
